name: qmf
expr: y4 = qmf(v4); y4_1 = qmf(v4, 1); y5 = qmf(v5); y5_1 = qmf(v5, 1); y8 = qmf(v8); ycol = qmf(col); ys = qmf([42]);
comment: Sig: y = qmf(x[, p]). Quadrature mirror filter. y(k) = (-1)^(k-1+p) · x(N-k+1). Default p=0 (identity-sign on the first element); p=1 negates. Coverage: even/odd-length + p=0/1 + length-8 + column input + single element. tol=0 (integer-stable on integer inputs).
